[ASSISTANT_SAID] Transferable skills include work experience, education, personal projects, language skills, communication skills, problem-solving skills, technical skills, leadership skills, interpersonal skills, and adaptability skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should tailor their resume to the US job market by using a reverse chronological format, incorporating industry-specific keywords, quantifying achievements, focusing on accomplishments, and emphasizing soft skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example of transferable skills on a resume includes a Marketing Coordinator position with achievements like increasing followers by 500% and collaborating on a product launch that resulted in 20% sales growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider using a functional or hybrid resume format if they have limited US work experience and include international experience.
